name.ja: HG 1/144 GUNDAM SIDE-F限定 ジムIII (地球連邦軍仕様/ボッシュ・ウェラー専用機)
name.en: HG 1/144 GUNDAM SIDE-F Limited GM III (Earth Federation military specification/Bosch Weller exclusive machine)

ja: 「RX-93ff νガンダム」をはじめとしたガンダムの様々な情報やグッズを取り扱うショップエリア「GUNDAM SIDE-F」の限定商品。
『機動戦士ガンダム F90』などに登場するボッシュ・ウェラー少尉のロンド・ベル隊移籍時の乗機とされる地球連邦軍カラーのジムIIIが登場！
• 機体色が地球連邦軍仕様の赤と白基調のカラーへ変更。
• バイザー部分はクリアパーツで表現。また、多彩な手首パーツが付属。
• プラモデルオリジナルのマーキングシールが付属。
• 各部関節が可動し、様々なポージングが可能。
～ACE PILOT LOG Memory of SIDE-Fとは～
“エース・パイロット”とMSが、宇宙世紀の歴史に刻んだ”ログ（記録）”をたどるWEB企画がGUNDAM SIDE-Fでも展開中！
en: This is a limited edition product of the shop area "GUNDAM SIDE-F " which handles various Gundam information and goods including " RX-93ff νGundam".

Introducing Jim III in the colors of the Earth Federation army, which is said to be the aircraft used by Ensign Bosch Weller, who appears in ``Mobile Suit Gundam F90'' and other movies, when he transferred to the Londo Bell Corps!
• The aircraft color has been changed to the red and white color scheme of the Earth Federation army.
• The visor part is expressed with clear parts. In addition, various wrist parts are included.
• Comes with the plastic model's original MarkingSeal.
• Each joint is movable, allowing various poses.
～What is ACE PILOT LOG Memory of SIDE-F～
A web project that traces the “logs” carved into the history of the Universal Century by “Ace Pilots” and MS is also being developed at GUNDAM SIDE-F!
